_readme: Dominic's price rule (27 Oct 2026): a menu price may only change when it is written on his Google sheet 'Roru - menu pricing comparison - October 2026' (tab 'Pricing chart', column 'Dom suggested price HK$'). public/menu.json is the source for every item; these are the exceptions for items NOT on that sheet. Read by lib/menu.ts (/menu text + schema) and scripts/menu-jsonld.mjs (homepage Menu JSON-LD).
_notOnOctSheetSections: menu.json lunch-board sections whose prices are not on the October sheet and were never on /menu: left out of the published menu data until confirmed.
_keepExistingMenuPrice: Not on the October sheet; menu.json (June board) says 48, /menu said 68 before 27 Oct 2026, so the schema keeps 68.
